small_independent_safety_scope.local_counterexample: Synthetic prepare-only request forgets a residence and explicitly keeps food preferences. Target and independent food fact have separate complete quotes in one shared source, no depends_on. Stubbed unavailable erasure_binding returns erasure_binding_deterministic with neighbor effect=erase and only target in operation IDs.
small_independent_safety_scope.probe_scope: sourceErasure=false, all model calls stubbed, initial positive verification explicitly a synthetic fixture; no database opened and no commit. The production source-erasure=true path and whole-write behavior were not newly exercised.
small_independent_safety_scope.proposed_minimum: When ambiguous candidate work lacks semantic classification, reject rather than synthesizing either erase or independent retain. Preserve automatic exact-boundary cases, explicit restore exclusions, no-candidate and ordinary no-erasure writes. Do not widen the original target set or discard source/keep evidence.
small_independent_safety_scope.expected_behavior_change: The existing degraded erasure-binding fixture would need an intentional fail-closed expectation, not a forged approval. Reviewed deletion paths should retain their existing successful fixtures.

ordinary capability fallback without ambiguous erasure work

priority_decision: Finish B03 recovery first. If a short safety hardening task is wanted next, choose the bounded erasure-binding capability guard. A B14 recovery attempt requires explicit inherited-evidence and keep-authorization contracts together; neither a quote-only patch nor a384 full-preview compatibility work is justified as the next small probe.
